full_page.content:
St. Bonaventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich.
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for favor found on desk this a.m. I hope everything went O.K. with the pay roll, etc. and that it may go favorablly.
God bless you all.
Pl.pray for - Sincerely yours in +0 Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap.
